hooks.command:
input=$(cat)
root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"
{
  printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.path // empty'
  printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input | tostring' | grep -oE '\*\*\* (Add|Update|Delete) File: [^\\"]+' | sed -E 's/^\*\*\* (Add|Update|Delete) File: //'
} | while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  case "$p" in /*) ;; *) p="$root/$p" ;; esac
  case "$p" in
    "$root/.cursor/environment.json" | "$root/.claude/settings.local.json") ;;
    "$root"/.claude/* | "$root"/.cursor/* | "$root"/.codex/* | "$root"/.agents/*)
      echo "BLOCKED: APM generates $p and overwrites it on the next pull. Edit the source in ai/.apm/ instead: rules in instructions/, skills in skills/, agents in agents/, hooks in hooks/." >&2
      exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty')
[ -n "$cmd" ] || exit 0
writes=$(printf '%s' "$cmd" | sed -E 's/[0-9]*>&[0-9]+//g; s/[0-9]*>+[[:space:]]*\/dev\/null//g')
printf '%s' "$writes" | grep -qE '>|(^|[^[:alnum:]_-])(tee|cp|mv|rm|touch|truncate|ln|install|rsync)([[:space:]]|$)|sed[[:space:]]+(-[a-zA-Z]*i|--in-place)' || exit 0
root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"
printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | tr ' \t;&|<>()' '\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n' | tr -d "\"'" | while IFS= read -r w; do
  case "$w" in .claude | .cursor | .codex | .agents | */.claude | */.cursor | */.codex | */.agents) w="$w/" ;; esac
  case "$w" in *.claude/* | *.cursor/* | *.codex/* | *.agents/*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
  w="${w#./}"
  case "$w" in "~/"*) w="$HOME/${w#\~/}" ;; /*) ;; *) w="$root/$w" ;; esac
  case "$w" in
    "$root/.cursor/environment.json" | "$root/.claude/settings.local.json") ;;
    "$root"/.claude/* | "$root"/.cursor/* | "$root"/.codex/* | "$root"/.agents/*)
      echo "BLOCKED: this command writes into a folder APM generates, and the next pull overwrites it. Edit the source in ai/.apm/ instead. Only need to read? Use your read tool." >&2
      exit 2 ;;
  esac
done
